newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARH ALERT - Salomon affirms Nice buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARH ALERT - Salomon affirms Nice buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers reiterated its strong buy recommendation for Nice Systems Ltd after the Israeli company reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings.

Nice earned $0.22 a share in the third quarter against Salomon's estimate of $0.21 and a loss of $0.03 in the third quarter of 1995. Salomon estimates the company will earn $0.74 a share in all of 1996 and $1.24 in 1997 against $0.06 in 1995.
Despite the strong third-quarter Salomon analyst Victor Halpert reduced his fourth-quarter revenue estimate to $11.2 million from $13.4 million.
"We expect lower Comint sales in the fourth-quarter given that the sales cycle for these products is long and unpredictable," Halpert said in a report.
Comint systems are used by military and government intelligence agencies to monitor and record transmissions from a variety of sources.

"Given our reduced Comint sales growth projections we have also cut our full-year 1997 revenue estimate for the group from $71.1 million to $64.1 million, 62 percent above our 1996 sales estimate," the report said.
Nevertheless, Salomon reiterated a strong buy recommendation.

"Our 12-month target price of $30-$35 per share reflects our view that Nice will trade broadly in line with its peers, although its revenue and earnings growth will be substantially above average for the telecoms equipment industry," the report said.
Nice shares on the Nasdaq are currently trading at 21-3/4.
